name: What are popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular modern bathroom design trends emphasize clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and functionality. This often includes floating vanities, large format tiles, walk-in showers with frameless glass, and smart technology integrations like heated floors or touchless faucets. Neutral color palettes, natural materials like wood and stone, and strategic lighting are also common. We stay updated on the latest trends to help you choose a design that is both stylish and practical for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern bathroom trends feature clean lines, floating vanities, walk-in showers, large tiles, neutral colors, natural materials, and smart tech.
